name: – Sven Mikser – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Moldova
part_text:
The European Parliament says Moldova has made strong progress on reforms and should be allowed to move ahead with joining the EU. It asks EU governments to open formal membership talks with Moldova without delay. It also calls for more money and support to help Moldova reform its courts, fight corruption, secure its energy supply and defend itself against Russian interference. The report is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- EU governments are urged to open all six membership negotiation groups with Moldova, starting with the basics.
- Moldova gets support for reforms, energy, defence and countering Russian interference; its citizens are affected.
- Next, EU governments decide whether to open the talks; the Parliament keeps pushing for 2028.
